text:
zoe: QA + PM ask: users keep missing the Undo because toast vanishes. Can we try a persistent banner in the timeline area that stays for X minutes after a rollback?
trent: Good idea. Banner sits above timeline entries and can include 'Undo' + 'View details'. Keeps toast ephemeral, timeline persistent.
marta: UX constraints: banner mustn't be modal or steal focus. Keyboard users should be able to tab to it. SR announcement when it appears is needed.
kevin: From infra: we can expose `undo_window_seconds` (default 600). UI can poll `/rollouts/:id/state` for `reconciled_percent`. Also add `history_anchor_id` for deep links.
maya: Accessibility: when the banner appears announce: 'Rollback complete. Undo available for 10 minutes.' Use aria-live=polite for the banner. The Undo button should have aria-label 'Undo rollback to v{n}, restores previous traffic allocation' and clear focus styles.
lia: Contrast: banner background is token-banner-1; text contrast right now ~3.2:1. Need to bump either bg or text to 4.5:1. Prefer using token-banner-2 for compliance.
zoe: Copy ideas for banner: 1) 'Rollback to v{n} complete. Undo available for 10 minutes.' 2) 'Rollback complete 10m undo window.' 3) 'Version {n} rolled back. Undo in timeline.' I vote 1 for clarity.
trent: Motion: when rollback finishes and banner appears, animate a 180ms slide-down. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and jump instead.
marta: Interaction model: toast: short status + 'View history' CTA. Banner: persistent, with 'Undo' + 'View diff'. Undo triggers modal confirmation with small diff preview and a CTA 'Confirm undo'.
kevin: We'll add API flag `undo_available_until` and `can_undo` boolean. Backend will gate the Undo button. Also add audit details: `triggered_by`, `trigger_reason`.
maya: SR details: timeline entries should expose humanized time for sighted users (eg '3 minutes ago') and full timestamp in a tooltip or SR-only text. VoiceOver should read the humanized string followed by the ISO when requested.
lia: Figma: I'll add banner variants (normal, compact, error-state if undo fails), include keyboard-focused state and 44px min touch targets. Add token swap for banner BG to token-banner-2.
zoe: Analytics: track 'undo_banner_shown', 'undo_clicked', 'undo_confirmed', 'undo_dismissed'. Use these to set default undo_window.
trent: Small copy tweak for canary controls: change 'Pause' -> 'Pause new traffic' everywhere (button label and tooltip).
marta: Summary of action items: 1) Banner copy: 'Rollback to v{n} complete. Undo available for 10 minutes.' 2) Add undo_window_seconds + undo_available_until fields (infra) 3) Expose reconciled_percent + history_anchor_id 4) Banner ARIA strings + Undo aria-labels 5) Token change to token-banner-2 for contrast 6) Motion reduced variant + 180ms slide 7) Figma frames + keyboard states 8) Analytics events.
kevin: I'll file the infra ticket and add the API fields.
maya: I'll create the a11y checklist and SR strings.
lia: I'll prototype the banner and update Figma.
zoe: I'll make the product doc and set default undo window to 10 mins; can change after we see analytics.
prod-bot: Reminder: don't forget to add e2e test for undo flow and a11y tests for banner focus/announce.
marta: Thanks all 1; please link Figma + tickets when ready.
